answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-vouching grove: every new agent must be invited by an established member who locks a crystal deposit as collateral, while a shared atlas graph records who vouched for whom. If a cluster of identities is later exposed as Sybil, slashing burns the vouchers crystal bonds and erases the atlas edges that seeded them, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand real stakes, and one detection event collapses the whole trees collateral.
